description: React component for selecting and editing geographic zones on Google Maps, including address autocomplete and polygon editing features.

classes.name: CustomGoogleMapsLocationZoneBounds
classes.description: React functional component for managing Google Maps zone boundaries with polygon editing and address autocomplete.

methods.name: onHandlerAutoCompleteSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles selection of an address from autocomplete suggestions, geocodes to get coordinates, and updates map center.

methods.name: onClickGoogleMaps
methods.description: Adds a point to the polygon path when the map is clicked.

methods.name: onSetCenterAndPolygon
methods.description: Initializes polygon and center based on provided path data.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Updates polygon path and center when polygon vertices are edited.

methods.name: onLoadPolygon
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for polygon editing events.

methods.name: onUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners when polygon component unmounts.
